section.title: Users and Roles Managment Tutorial
section.p: The "Users and Roles Management" tutorial defines a complete application to manage clients and their associated rights for a web application. The defined data model is compatible with the database realm of Tomcat. The domain model is specified as an ArgoUML model. The pmMDA generates the source code artifacts using the DOG framework. The project can be compiled and executed. All required files and libraries are packaged with the tutorial. A copy of the DOG jar file and of all the dependent libraries are available in the library directory.
The "Hypersonic SQL" database is used in the tutorial. The user does not need to install any database package. The HSQL is configured as a standalone persistent engine. The access mode is.

To initialize a new database the following statements must be executed. In the tutorial an empty database is already provided with some data. This database can be used for the first experiments with pmMDA and the provided frameworks.
section.source: java -cp hsqldb.jar org.hsqldb.util.ScriptTool -database ./db/users -script ojbcore-schema-hsql.sql java -cp hsqldb.jar org.hsqldb.util.ScriptTool -database ./db/users -script createTablesHSQL.sql

section.title: Instructions
section.p: The following steps must be performed to generate, compile and run the roles management tutorial. The instructions assumes that you have downloaded and installed the pmMDA binary distribution and the source distribution. The DOG framework is optional and needs only to be downloaded if you want to extensively modify the example.
The first example run the User Roles Management example as a two tiers application

dl.dd: The application is compiled with ant. ant -f build-examples.xml build-rich-client-tests
The application is started with ant. ant -f build-examples.xml run-rich-client-tests
